cleanup.cleanup: Communes use mechanical collection; windward Atlantic coasts overwhelmed in peak years, with H2S health alerts
cleanup.resort: Hotels rake frontage; leeward sites rarely affected
cleanup.speed: Variable: hours to weeks; check prefecture H2S bulletins

safety.advisory: France: exercise increased caution (Level 2 via France, verify); Dominica Level 1 (verify)
notes: Hydrogen-sulfide from rotting sargassum can close Atlantic beaches - heed prefecture alerts
